reason: shadcn's combobox.tsx wraps @base-ui/react 1.9.0 Combobox, whose Root, Portal, Value and Collection render no element, whose closed popup is unmounted, and whose lists, chips and anchors are driven by React render functions and refs. A server-rendered Phlex + Stimulus port with no new JavaScript dependency (maintainer constraint of the phlex-shadcn-adoption epic) needs one controller host and somewhere to ship markup that Base UI only creates on the client; none of these carries a data-slot, classes or a box, so the compared DOM is unchanged after connect(). Ruby cannot pass DOM refs, React elements or JS callbacks, so those props map to selectors, as_child, server-side callables and events.
api: Combobox renders one <div style="display: contents" data-controller="chadcn--combobox"> host (no data-slot, classes or other data attributes besides controller wiring) around its children and hidden inputs
Combobox::Content anchor: is a CSS selector string instead of an element/ref; useComboboxAnchor has no Ruby equivalent
Combobox::Trigger as_child: stands for Base UI's render prop
item_to_string_label:, item_to_string_value:, item_equal_to_value: are Ruby callables evaluated on the server; item equality defaults to == instead of Object.is
filter: takes the named filters "fuzzy" (default, primitives/scorer.js), "contains" (Base UI Intl.Collator) or nil instead of a function; Base UI callbacks are the chadcn--combobox:* events
inline, grid, virtualized, filteredItems, filterQuery, actionsRef and inputRef are not ported
value-change reports the item's form value ({ value }), not the item object; item identity on the client is the form value and equality callables run on the server
modal: true locks the page scroll and adds the backdrop but does not trap focus (the input keeps it; Tab leaves and closes, like the non-modal popup)
structure: display: contents host around the Root children and hidden inputs
closed Combobox::Content markup inside an inert <template>, mounted into body > div[data-base-ui-portal] and removed on close

Combobox::Value ships inert <template> markers around its live content (start, end) and the block output of each possible selection inside the start marker; they stay in the document (not removed on connect) so a Turbo snapshot can rebuild chips and the selected label

Combobox::Clear ships its closed button in an inert <template> before the live button, and Combobox::List ships the item indicator in an inert <template>, so the controller can mount them after a client-side selection
data-chadcn--combobox-* markers on parts (ignored by the runner) carry item identity and part roles for the controller
